def with_pattern(pattern, regex_group_count=None):
    r'''Attach a regular expression pattern matcher to a custom type converter
    function.

    This annotates the type converter with the :attr:`pattern` attribute.

    EXAMPLE:
        >>> import parse
        >>> @parse.with_pattern(r'\d+')
        ... def parse_number(text):
        ...     return int(text)

    is equivalent to:

        >>> def parse_number(text):
        ...     return int(text)
        >>> parse_number.pattern = r'\d+'

    :param pattern: regular expression pattern (as text)
    :param regex_group_count: Indicates how many regex-groups are in pattern.
    :return: wrapped function
    '''

    def decorator(func):
        func.pattern, func.regex_group_count = pattern, regex_group_count
        return func

    return decorator
```

def extract_format(format, extra_types):
    '''Pull apart the format [[fill]align][0][width][.precision][type]'''

    def take(s):
        n = next((i for i, c in enumerate(s) if not c.isdigit()), len(s))
        return s[:n], s[n:]

    fill = align = None
    if format[0] in '<>=^':
        align, format = format[0], format[1:]
    elif len(format) > 1 and format[1] in '<>=^':
        fill, align, format = format[0], format[1], format[2:]

    zero, format = (True, format[1:]) if format[:1] == '0' else (False, format)

    width, format = take(format)
    if format.startswith('.'):
        format = format[1:]
        precision, format = take(format)

    type = format
    if type and type not in ALLOWED_TYPES and type not in extra_types:
        raise ValueError('format spec %r not recognised' % type)

    return {
        'format': format,
        'extra_types': extra_types,
        'fill': fill,
        'align': align,
        'zero': zero,
        'width': width,
        'type': type,
        **({'precision': precision} if 'precision' in locals() else {}),
    }

def extract_format(format, extra_types):
    '''Pull apart the format [[fill]align][0][width][.precision][type]'''

    def take(s):
        n = next((i for i, c in enumerate(s) if not c.isdigit()), len(s))
        return s[:n], s[n:]

    fill = align = None
    if format[0] in '<>=^':
        align, format = format[0], format[1:]
    elif len(format) > 1 and format[1] in '<>=^':
        fill, align, format = format[0], format[1], format[2:]

    zero, format = (True, format[1:]) if format[:1] == '0' else (False, format)

    width, format = take(format)
    if format.startswith('.'):
        format = format[1:]
        precision, format = take(format)

    type = format
    if type and type not in ALLOWED_TYPES and type not in extra_types:

        'extra_types': extra_types,
        'fill': fill,
        'align': align,
        'zero': zero,
        'width': width,
        'type': type,
        **({'precision': precision} if 'precision' in locals() else {}),

    def take(s):
        n = next((i for i, c in enumerate(s) if not c.isdigit()), len(s))

        align, format = format[0], format[1:]

        precision, format = take(format)

    type = format

        'extra_types': extra_types,
        'fill': fill,
        'align': align,
        'zero': zero,

        'type': type,

    '''Pull apart the format [[fill]align][0][width][.precision][type]'''

    def take(s):
        n = next((i for i, c in enumerate(s) if not c.isdigit()), len(s))

        align, format = format[0], format[1:]
    elif len(format) > 1 and format[1] in '<>=^':
        fill, align, format = format[0], format[1], format[2:]

    zero, format = (True, format[1:]) if format[:1] == '0' else (False, format)

    width, format = take(format)
    if format.startswith('.'):
        format = format[1:]
        precision, format = take(format)

    type = format
    if type and type not in ALLOWED_TYPES and type not in extra_types:
        raise ValueError('format spec %r not recognised' % type)

        'format': format,
        'extra_types': extra_types,
        'fill': fill,
        'align': align,
        'zero': zero,
        'width': width,
        'type': type,
        **({'precision': precision} if 'precision' in locals() else {}),
